text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error classes: SIGSEGV, OOM during long-context model runs. Paging observed on node-42. auto-retries increased. Please triage.

alice-oncall: I'm paged. Investigating now. @carla can you grab runtime logs and dmesg? @bob check gateway routing and fallback.

carla-runtime: grabbing logs... dmesg shows OOM killer invocation for model-runner PID 2345 on node-42; also userland backtrace indicates segfault in quantized attention kernel. snippet:
```
[ 12345.678901] Out of memory: Killed process 2345 (model-runner) total-vm:...kB, anon-rss:...kB
[ 12345.679012] model-runner[2345]: segfault at ... ip ... call ...
```
Also seeing KV cache size spike ~4x for some long sequences.

bob-eng-sre: gateway metrics show 5xx -> 8% (p95 err). Auto-fallback partially enabled but not covering enterprise customers. I'll trigger manual rollout to fallback-pool and gate by route flag.

alice-oncall: Live mitigation plan:
1) disable batching for model long-context-2
2) route enterprise -> fallback-llama-13b-8bit (lower mem)
3) scale dedicated pool us-west-2 +2 nodes
4) enable aggressive kvcache eviction
I'll coordinate canary and give updates every 5m.

dave-support: Noted. Affected customers include two enterprise tenants; support has open case and is DMing them. Any ETA?

carla-runtime: Applying safe kernel path on one canary node to avoid the quant-race double-free. Command:
```
kubectl exec -n runtime node/node-42 -- /usr/local/bin/replace-kernel --mode=safe
```
Capturing backtraces and heap info now.

bob-eng-sre: Routing flag flipped (rollout_id=rr-175812) — 25% traffic to fallback. Initial canary: 5xx down 8% -> 1.5%, p95 latency +120ms. No new OOMs on canary.

alice-oncall: Good. If stable for 10m we ramp to 100%. Opening postmortem ticket PM-INC-2025-175812. @people-ops please note on-call handoff.

carla-runtime: Root cause hypothesis: KV cache growth under long sequences + quantized attention kernel race -> double-free / OOM under memory pressure. Reproducer being built.

dave-support: Impact numbers: ~120k calls affected, ~18m window of elevated errors. Preparing customer-facing blurb.

incident-bot: Incident annotated (severity=SEV2). Runbook: runtime-oom-segfault#live. Pages: alice-oncall, bob-eng-sre, carla-runtime.

alice-oncall: Mitigations ramped to 100% fallback; autoscale +2 applied. 5xx rate returned to baseline. Moving to monitoring and RCA tasks. Closing active pager, will hand to weekday oncall for follow-up.

alice-oncall: :thumbsup:
